what: Bambu Studio setup on a GitHub-hosted runner, measured for issue #314 (plain @claude run, no Bambu login)
studio: 02.08.02.61 (BambuStudio_ubuntu24.04 AppImage, sha256 d501b103… = GitHub's asset digest)

cold_fresh_runner.note: total includes a fixed 10 s prompt watch, since shortened to ~2 s

first_run_by_hand_for_comparison: SSL prompt, 6-page wizard, plug-in download (about 1 s), profile-update prompt, three Beta prompts: each one a screenshot and a click for the agent. No hang this time; the PR #95 run hung at 100 % CPU after the plug-in install and lost ~4 min
arm64: Bambu's plug-in endpoint returns an x86-64 build for X-BBL-OS-Type linux (libbambu_networking.so: ELF 64-bit x86-64) and nothing for linux_arm, linux_aarch64 or linux-arm64. Flathub builds Studio for aarch64, but without the plug-in it can't log in, send or show the camera
